usedFor: Webshipper holds orders, shipments and returns, and Google AI Studio (Gemini) writes text from them with “Generate Content”.

bestTemplate.name: “Return Created” in Webshipper, then “Generate Content” in Google AI Studio (Gemini)
bestTemplate.why: A new return becomes the moment to draft text from a prompt, such as a summary of what came back.

watchOut: “Generate Content” works from a prompt, so order or return details reach Gemini only if you place them there.
